nom: Avène Tolerance Control Skin Recovery Balm

avis.titre: Love this product but the pump stopped working…
avis.texte: I absolutely love this moisturizer. I have super sensitive skin around my eyes and this does a great job at moisturizing without irritating. My only complaint is the pump…. My first tube I was able to use it all up without wasting any. Im now on my second and maybe halfway through the pump stopped working and because its sterile and preservative free, its not like you can just unscrew it to get the rest out. So basically half the product is wasted and for $42 that is beyond frustrating.

This cream is excellent for skin recovery. My circumstance was preliminary facial skin cancer where I have completed a treatment program & this was suggested for afterwards. Great idea & my skin looks great. Just a little bit on area at night is all I do.
When nothing worked for my sensitive clog prone combination skin this came through!!!!

I have developed an almost constant red flushed hot face and redness all around my eyes. I researched topical products to address it and Avene Tolerance was listed with good commentary esp the timeframe for results after the 1st use. Failure!

I have very dry, irritated, sensitive skin around my mouth and nose… tried so many products but nothing worked until I started using this and their Cicalfate+ serum daily and once a week I use their Cicalfate+ restorative protective cream… all three are amazing I just wish they were not so expensive specially considering how small they are.

I have sensitive, reactive, and acne prone skin. Anything i try can make my perioral dermatitis flare or i end up with closed comedones. This moisturizer is the only one that doesnt flare me up and doesnt cause closed comedones!!! I love it! Leaves my face smooth with no greasy feeling!

avis.titre: The best for sensitive skin and rosacea!
avis.texte: I have seriously sensitive skin that will react if you look at it wrong. I started using this cream a few years back and it has saved my life. I have oily skin, but the rosacea makes my skin patchy with dry spots, and this lotion helps SOOO much. I use it morning and night and even layer it under makeup. Avene has so many great products, many that don't include fragrance of any kind (even natural), and because of that, I'll be a loyal customer for as long as they keep it up. If you have sensitive skin, are prone to redness, and/or have rosacea, try this face lotion!

Loooooovveee this balm! Not too heavy, not too light. My skin is hypersensitive and reactive to everything, but not this! It was a relief to my very irritated skin diring pregnancy and now postpartum. The only downside is that I wish it wasnt so small for the price. But its worth it for a product i finally don't react to!

This stuff is amazing. I have Perioral dermatitis and I have tried all the creams. This one has truly worked in helping my get rid of it. Don't be discouraged that the balm is somewhat thick (many recommend lightweight moisturizers for PD). It truly does the trick.

I tried this product for 2 weeks and I now have dry flaky skin on my cheeks and nose. I bought this product because I have sensitive skin that gets a little drier in the winter months, but my skin has never been this dry in my life! Pros: it dries quickly and applys nice under makeup. Not greasy. Cons: dried up my skin into a flaky mess.

avis.titre: Great for people suffering for hypothyroidism!
avis.texte: Since I have hypothyroidism, my skin was always super dry and I would have a lot of rashes as a result. But, this lotion is sensitive enough not to irritate my skin furthermore and durable enough to lock in moisture to eliminate dryness without clogging up my pores. Happy i came across this brand because I have wasted a lot of money before finding this product.

I use the balm daily, and it has made a huge difference in my complexion. I have very dry, aging (post-menopausal) skin, but it is still prone to acne occasionally, particularly if I try to use heavy moisturizing creams. This is the only thing that seems to work for me. My skin is finally clear and smooth!

Please never remove this. It's the only moisturizer I've ever been able to use without triggering my acne!! I never have any product related breakouts anymore!! Finding a good moisturizer that worked for my skin was soo hard. This is so perfect and I've been using it for probably a year now.
Excellent moisturizer, slides on nicely and a little thicker than the cream for dtuer skin

I use retinol and aha products regularly so every now and then my skin peels and gets red and sensitive. I have tried a lot of soothing and calming products on the market to fix my occasionally irritated skin but so far this one is the only one that doesn't hurt when applied and that actually calms my skin down. I have used both its cream and balm version. They are both great but I like the balm one a little better.

Avene recently changed to the pump feature. My last three containers have had 5e pump quit work8ng halfway through the bottle. The top is impossible to remove, so I had to cut a corner from the bottom edge so I could get the balm out. Please go back to the old packaging!
Love this new product. It's a balm and I expected it to go on like a balm. It goes on much smoother and it's so soothing to my skin. Will be purchasing this product again.

avis.titre: My only subscription service is this face moisturizer
avis.texte: With my sensitive and severely dry skin, this is the best moisturizer. I have it on renewal every 30 days, and truly use it up every month. It has great ingredients that are not harsh on the skin. And make my face feel soft and plump, especially during the winter months. Incredible product, highly recommend

This is a wonderful cream to use as a last step in skincare at night. I have cancer and need all the hydration I can get after chemo. This is a great final layer. I have also used it on my dry hands for moisture. And I already bought a backup. I use several skincare layers, some are Avene and some are other products. But I like this for the final step.
This is a good cream for mildly dry skin. Alone it isn't enough moisture but with a layer of oil -very good. No fragrance at all. Thank you.
Tolerance face cream is wonderful. My skin is very sensitive and never a breakout or clogged pore. Hydration is lasting.

I bought this one because auto recommended when I choose the "tolerance cream" I used to use, but it out of stock and discontinued product. It says they are similar, but after using one bottle, my face keeps peeling actually they are not the same thing. It is not gentle enough for my face.
Glides onto the skin nicely and leaves a nice hydrated finish to the skin. Very soothing for dryness without clogging pores

avis.titre: Use Avene for smooth, calm and beautiful skin!
avis.texte: I love Avene products. They keep my rosacea under control and make my skin look beautiful and feel wonderful. I get lots of compliments on my skin and questions as to what I use. I am 67 years old and my skin looks and feels like 17 years old. I have never had plastic surgery. I believe the first key to anti-aging is to use SPF and Avene's is the only SPF product that does not irritate my face. The second key is to use products for sensitive skin. I love Avene's hypersensitive skin products such as Xera Calm and Tolerance Control as well as Cicalfate and Retrinol products. And the third key is to use Avene's Eau Thermale Thermal Spring Water. I even spray it in my dogs' faces sometimes especially on hot days and they are gorgeous dogs!!

I love the lightness but moisturizing feel from this Tolerance Control lotion. I have dry skin that is sensitive and prone to redness. I use this at night when I need a lighter but consistent moisturizer and it never fails. Highly recommend for those in search of good product.

I am still very disappointed that the skin recovery cream for sensitive/dry skin was discontinued. This product was to replace it, but it doesn't hydrate nearly as well as the original formula(recovery cream). I have a little left of the discontinued product left so it is an accurate comparison.
Smooth and soothing to the skin; very effective for sensitive skin

Was using Tolerance Extreme Crème until it was discontinued and was told that this would work instead of that-just got back from aesthetician who said skin was very dehydrated-I also use antioxidant lotion and Fort with it-not pleased at all!

It really helps to control the redness on my face that l get from eczema. I actually have two tubes because l keep one in my pocketbook to reapply if needed throughout the day. There is absolutely no residue and the texture is smooth. Highly recommend.
This is great stuff, but I have found that it is just too much money. And the small tube is supposed to last 30 days, but I find the amount I need to use makes it run out much sooner.
I have extremely sensitive acne prone rosacea dry mature skin. This moisturizer is the best I have found.

Best moisturizer for my skin type (dry, sensitive, acne prone). I love how it is fragrance free and simple ingredients. I can use it in both the summer and winter during the day. I especially like the pump as it's hygienic and travel friendly.

When I think of a balm, I think of a really thick, dense, almost 'oily' or 'waxy' feeling product but this is more like a thicker cream. Maybe it is in the translation from French to English - like 'balm' has a different meaning there? I do love this as a moisturizer but I wouldn't call it a balm and I don't think it is helping with my skin barrier. I appreciate that there is no added fragrance, I love the packaging too. And it didn't sting my HYPER sensitive skin at all which is incredibly rare.
My favorite face lotion. Just wish it came in a bigger container.

In recent years i've developed excema on my eyelids, chin & ear lobes. I've tried so many moisturizers that claim to help reduce redness and lock in moisture, but it wasn't until I found this product that my skin changed for the better. I bought the 3 pack sample with the facewash and thermal water and fell in love with all. First purchased back in September 2022 & still using the same 3 products today. I even tried to change back to some old products that used to work for me and my skin returned to the brittle and scaly old self that used to be. I remain consistent with this brand, and they have shown me love back, my skin soaks this stuff in and doesnt break me out whatsoever. Super gentle and refreshing. One of my favorite pros is that it leaves my irritated and stinging skin, smooth and calm. if you have irritated skin that stings, even when you put your moisturizer on it, this product is definitely for you and will help with that sensation.

I recently had a terrible flare up of hysensitivity. This is very soothing, rich, and quickly calmed my face down. No acne flare up either. I will not return to other products. I intend to continue to baby my finicky skin.
The cream is just the right thickness. It is very hydrating for my skin.
I miss tolerance extreme emulsion so much. Please bring it back :,(

avis.titre: So Waxy I Immediately Washed My Face
avis.texte: I am so disappointed. This balm made my skin feel greasy and like it needed to be washed. Avene, please bring back the exact formula of Tolerance Extreme Cream. I used that every day for 4+ years. I was devastated to find it was discontinued, but was told to try Tolerance Control Skin Recovery Cream in its place. I was hoping it would be the same product with a different name. I tried that and it did not make my skin feel plump and full, like the Extreme Cream used to. I hoped that the Tolerance Control Skin Recovery Balm would be a substitute, so I tried that next. This balm is extremely waxy and greasy. As soon as I applied it, I felt the need to wash my face. I only return things that I know I will never use or recommend. I returned this.
I really like this balm, it is rich but it doesn't feel greasy. I love that it is fragrance free!
This is my favorite Avene product! So much that I finished my first tube and bought two more! It has been very helpful for my dry face this winter and I love using it at night over my serums.
moisturizes but does not cause any problems with redness or irritation

I really wanted to love this because the tolerance extreme cream was my holy grail after struggling for so long to find a moisturizer. Unfortunately they've been out of stock for months and I thought I'd give this a try. It clogged my pores so bad. I assume it was the shea butter, even though the product says non-comedogenic. I immediately got closed comedones and milia after starting this. Sad I won't be able to use it after paying for it.
Absolutely LOVE this balm. My skin feels so silky & hydrated when I use it. already purchased another one! ❤️

avis.titre: Face has "grown" sensitive after prolonged use.
avis.texte: I have sensitive skin prone to itchiness with certain products, and has recently started to bother my skin. Please recommend other possible option!

avis.titre: I think I can finally stop searching!
avis.texte: This is almost a direct copy/paste of my cleanser review, but it applies to this balm, too. My skin is extremely reactive lately. I am acne-prone and my dermatologist has me on a benzoyl peroxide/clindamycin topical in the morning and a tretinoin topical at night. This combination (particularly in the mornings) can cause a lot of stinging, burning, itching, and discomfort after cleansing and applying the topical, and that's before I apply my moisturizer. Moisturizers have traditionally amplified these sensations and it can be so bad that I will avoid my routine for a few days, which exacerbates my acne. I have to use moisturizer due to the drying nature of the medications, and I absolutely must use sunscreen, which is also extremely painful. The problem has been that all of this HURTS! I've only used this moisturizer twice so far, once last night after my tretinoin (usually the time I have no issues, even with other gentle moisturizers), and once this morning following my bzp/clin topical. So far, I am IN LOVE! The morning application didn't burn and make me want to rip my skin off. I'm also using the tolerance extremely gentle cleanser and the combination is lovely. It doesn't burn, itch, sting, or hurt. My face feels moisturized and comfortable, soft, and it doesn't appear overly flaky. I am so thrilled I found this skincare line by total accident. I love my Cetaphil, but even that hasn't cut it with these topical medications. Maybe now I'll actually keep up on the daily ro
Dermatologist recommended for my Rosacea. It is very soothing and hydrating.
Smoother and brighter skin in only one week! Loving this purchase!
It help relieve the redness on my irritated neck, little pricey
I have some dry rough places on my neck and this has totally erased them. Also, there is no better product on the market than Avene Retrinal and Retrinal eyes.

I have extremely sensitive skin for half of the year. I have been a dedicated user of the Avene Tolerance line for 7-8 years. It is the only thing that I can put on my skin. It has saved my skin more times than I can count, repaired my moisture barrier when nothing else could . For some reason, they changed their lines and have added more ingredients—-including CITRIC ACID in this specific product. I bought it to try it (not even realizing the ingredients changed) and immediately had a reaction. I am devastated.for those of you with sensitive skin, allergic skin, eczema, dry skin- you know what I mean!!! AVENE PLEASE BRING BACK THE ORIGINAL FORMULA

This moisturizer is extremely lightweight but really leaves my skin feeling hydrated!!! I read reviews about how hard it is to use the dispenser, but I do have not had any problem with the pump working. I will definitely be buying this again!

I bought this for 50% off during the skin event recently and ended up returning it. I didn't find any relief of the mild redness that I have on my face, and the pump and consistency reminded me of sunblock. It actually felt like sunblock too, after application. It felt like it was sitting on my face rather than being absorbed (this is after about an hour of application). I am happy with my current night cream (Belif Aqua Bomb Sleeping Mask) but figured for the price and great reviews, this was worth a shot. No luck for me, back to the store it went!

I rushed to my local Ulta during a rosacea flare-up to get Cicaplast balm, as it's usually the only thing that can provide relief from the intense burning and itching. They were out of stock, so I had to find something else on the spot. Avene products were right next to La Roche-Posay, and this balm had great reviews, so I took a chance and bought it. Washed my face (with vanicream soap-free bar) upon getting home, applied a generous dollop of this balm, and hallelujah! Within 5 minutes the burning and stinging had significantly decreased. A couple of hours later my skin felt back to normal and comfortable. The texture is a lot nicer than Cicaplast, much lighter and creamier, and it's much more moisturizing than my current ceramide cream, so I'm switching to this as daily moisturizer. After just two days, my skin already feels less rough and tight (although the bumps are still there, that's another story), and no itching or burning to report. Highly recommend.

avis.titre: Love product, Ulta is the problem
avis.texte: Bought during save skin event. Received email confirmation. Next week received email that it would be delayed due to shipping issues. Hours later, email says "order cancelled". Contacted ulta over a dozen times. Kept getting bot-like responses that sale is over, watch for another sale. NO, Ulta make this right. I suggested they transfer order to local store so I can pick up since it was in stock (didn't buy it at store due to previous issues buying items and finding them used or old at home). They said sale over. I said send when restocked. If you didn't have enough for a sales event, why promote. Bait and switch tactics. Extremely poor customer service right through to supervisor level. This is why I have decreased my purchases from Ulta over the years. In today's economy, sellers should work with buyers to keep them. Not alienate them. Again worst experience yet with Ulta and it keeps getting worse each ordeal with them.

avis.titre: Please Bring Back Tolerance Extreme Cream
avis.texte: I bought this since it was recommended as a replacement for Tolerance Extreme Cream, unfortunately this is nothing like it. It caused my skin to burn and it h after using it for a few days. I'm so disappointed. I would have used the Extreme Cream forever and now I'm left trying to find something that works.

I have mature sensitive reactive skin. I can become dehydrated and my face irritated if I'm not using the right products.. This balm keeps my skin moisturized and hydrated longer than any other product I have used, and I have used many. I have not found a better product. It does not break me out no matter how much I apply and the next morning my skin is not dried. I am so happy for this Avene recovery balm.
Nice, quality product as always. Have been using cream for a few months and will stay with this line.
Whenever my skin is allergic, Avene is my only choice to help me through the period.

This is a thick unscented cream that absorbs quickly. I have rosacea and the redness can get out of control unless you're on top of it. This product is now part of my routine. They also make a fantastic eye cream.

avis.titre: Worth trying for eczema-prone, reactive, skin
avis.texte: I would describe my 30 year old skin as desert-like. I have persistent flaky patches that just never seem to be soothed unless I use at least 2 moisturizers and vaseline on top. This balm has been excellent, better than any moisturizer I've tried since my skin has been this reactive and dry. I'm really taken aback at how this makes my dryest flaky patches look like normal skin. Goes well underneath makeup as well. If I feel dry throughout the day, I put this on and my skin feels and looks refreshed. I also like to use it when I have an itchy flare or hive, and it seems to calm it down. The texture is like a rich moisturizer, not greasy feeling like vaseline but it leaves a lovely protective barrier. I live in a dry climate, so I sometimes add something more occlusive (petrolatum-based) on top at night, but that's just me. I honestly would recommend anyone with eczema or flaky skin to try this, especially if it's on sale.
This cream was suggested by my dermatologist. It worked miracles. It has been the only brand I used and will use in the future.

Wow this is fantastic! I had a skin infection and needed a prescription to clear it up. Unfortunately the prescription left my skin red and peeling. This balm saved the day. The redness disappeared within a day and the peeling went away after 3 days. This does not feel like a balm at all. It feels like a lightweight lotion and absorbs quickly. I was even able to apply a bit of foundation over it with no pilling. I highly recommend!
Love this product pm and sometimes am use too. Very moisturizing and doesn't irritate my sensitive rosacea and seb derm skin. :)

I have sensitive, dry skin that can get red when it's irritated but this product makes the redness go away. I like to apply this lotion for my redness and then top it off with Vaseline/petroleum jelly to lock in that extra moisture.

avis.titre: I stock up when this is on sale
avis.texte: This lotion is the best there is for sensitive skin. I use it everyday. I have serums, toners, masks, etc that contain the actives I want, but this is my moisturizer because my skin LOVES IT. It is fabulous as an eye cream, too, which is great because I have seriously sensitive eyes and have never found one that is as gentle and effective as this. I hope this is NEVER DISCONTINUED. I will cry. Literally.
I use this every night after I apply my retinol. It helps keep my dry skin moisturized and less dry due to the retinol. This is my second tube of it and am going to purchase another!

I bought this product on a whim, and I'm so glad I did. It's has a rich feeling and works great under makeup. It has helped my sensitivity and compromised skin barrier and I even notice reduced redness! Best part- no stinging! This product lasts a surprisingly long time given its smaller size. I will buy again and again.
The formula is basic and simple, which is a plus. The downside is that it is overpriced for such mundane ingredients.

I really loved how this went on and made a noticeable difference in my skin! I sometimes get a bit of redness (hormonal) and this 100% helped to make my chest area feel and look less red and supple and moisturized. I definitely will be purchasing this product in the future! 5stars!!

I got this to compare with the Tolerance Cream. I really like this too, slightly more waxy and occlusive finish - might be better for winter months but still very lightweight. I use the Tolerance Cream and Balm on rotation and both work well. Relatively simple ingredient list for the price and not that much product, that's the only drawback. Love that it doesn't cause irritation.

I normally have sensitive combo skin, that gets more oily in the summer. However, during pregnancy I developed much drier skin and red flushed bumpy cheeks. A normal heavy moisturizer didn't work, it just sat on top of my skin (I tried several). This absorbed really well, took away the redness (mostly) and the bumps! Certain areas looked/felt like they were on the verge of a breakout but it wasn't, it was just dryness! This was absolutely a skin saver for me! Love that it's fragrance free with minimal ingredients. I tried the cream first but needed more moisture.

Hi i do recommend this cream I had tried many in the pass nothing was helped but this cream really help right away to calm the skin and to soothing ( I wait a week so i can taste it and write a review EXCELLENT. Thank you for your hard work God bless you.
I have tried this for a couple weeks and I like how it helps with my excema on my face and eyelids.

avis.titre: Love this product so much !!! Life saver for sensitive skin
avis.texte: My skin is sensitive. I used retinol two weeks ago and started to feel dry and burn on my face. Then I used this product and the result was overnight! I couldn't believe that the next morning i didn't feel my face burning . It soothe and smooth my skin overall. I'm so satisfied .

I have always had problems with skin sensitivity. My combination skin requires good cleansing and even better moisturizer. I love the way that Avéne Tolerance Control Soothing Recovery Balm makes my skin feel, look and heal. This actually combatted the redness on my face and made it actually feel quenched! I have tried so many different serums, creams, lotions, etc. This one lives up to its word and puts a smile on my face!

When I used this balm at first time, I didn't like it. So I bought some moisturizer from cheapest French skincare company. That made my skin burned, stretchy and extreme dry. So I wiped off and I applied this balm. WOW!! Soon after applying, my skin felt calm and moisturized. My skin really felt absorbing cream into deep. This balm saved my face! THANK YOU, THANK YOU! THANK YOU!! I loved old recovery cream But this balm is better than that. Best moisturizer! I'll not used other brand anymore!

Feels good, no over powering scent, used every day and evening .... Noticed no change or calming to my skin, but it did help hydrate it some. I don't think I will be buying it for myself, there are other products that works better for the same price point.

I absolutely love all Avene products but this one takes the cake. Whenever my skin has a bas reaction to something or just isn't doing to good this usually does the trick. It's amazing for sensitive skin and will leave your face smooth as ever. Great when you have skin irritating to soothe out the skin. Takes away redness and melts right into the skin. 10/10 product.

avis.titre: New Addition to my Daily Routine
avis.texte: I absolutely love this moisturizer, and will purchase again as soon as my free sample runs out. It's thicker than I expected, and I was concerned it might have a waxy feel, but it doesn't at all. Very nice creamy texture that absorbs quickly. My skin feels instantly soothed, moisturized, and softened a few seconds after applying. It also seems to minimize the appearance of enlarged pores, blackheads, and wrinkles, and hydrates any patches of dry flaky skin — all without feeling the least bit heavy or greasy. My only (very small) complaint is that the packaging is a bit unusual (a pump in a tube). It seems to work well, but I feel like a lot of product will stay stuck in the tube once I'm close to running out.

avis.titre: Avène Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm
avis.texte: I enjoyed trying out the Avène Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm. It went on easily and left my skin feeling smooth, moisturized, and refreshed.

In colder months and especially when the weather is changing, my skin get extremely sensitive and dry - so dry it gets scaly and flakey. This super light moisturizer was just what I needed for almost instant relief. I think the shea butter really adds to this product and have never used it on my face before. I have very expensive moisturizers and none of them work as well. I am obsessed with this product and recommend it to any one, especially if you have sensitive, dry &/or itchy skin.

I've used this product for two weeks and so far it's not made my face react which happens from a lot of face products. I would only use a small amount as it does go far and too much can leave your face feeling like it has a layer. I'll definitely keep using.

I used the Avène Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm to soothe my face after getting it waxed and it worked great! It really helps lessen the stinging sensation and will probably become a staple in my waxing routine.
I thoroughly enjoyed this project. It did not cause irritation or for my skin to get red and blotchy. My skin tolerated it well and was left smooth and refreshed.

I really like the way this product goes on. I used it after applying my serum and before lotion. It did not feel sticky or greasy. It absorbed quickly and had absolutely zero fragrance which is great. I do feel like it has helped my rosacea after just a couple weeks of use, so I will continue to use it and see if I have further improvement.

I have "angry" dry red skin on my forehead and no moisturizer alone was good enough to ease the uncomfortable feeling it caused. Now, I use a couple pumps of this, a good clean moisturizer and it makes a huge difference. I love that this product comes in a sterile container, as bacteria can cause it's own problems. I'm not fond of the smell, but that quickly disappears. If you have problem skin on your face/neck, get this, you'll like it.

avis.titre: Mild and effective skin recovery balm.
avis.texte: I got this Avène Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm to try for free through BzzAgent for my honest opinion and I am very happy with it. My skin had become quite reactive in recent years, and many face products do not work well for me. I have been using this skin recovery balm for the past 3 weeks and it has not caused any negative reactions on my skin, in fact it smoothed out some rough spots and it made my skin feel softer. I like that there is no scent to this as well because strongly scented products can become bothersome. This recovery balm came with a built in pump top and it is similar in texture to a medium thickness lotion. It absorbed quickly and did not feel heavy on my skin. It is definitely worth getting if you have sensitive and reactive skin.

Avène Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm is easy to use. I really liked that it requires a small amount to see and feel results. This balm is not greasy which another plus for this product. My skin looks and feels very refresh, smooth and natural.

This is an excellent moisturizer!!! When I received it,I expected it to be thick and difficult to apply. On the contrary, a small amount was just enough to cover the entire face and neck. What I loved about it, my face was not feeling dry at the end of day as is the case with most other face creams. Either they dont moisturize for long or are very greasy. I also used it on my pre-teen who is not particularly good about regular skin care and dry patches on face. It was soothing for him and was impressed. Avène Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm will be a daily use moisturizer in my bag now.

This was my first time using a face balm and I like that it left my skin feeling soft and moisturized. It has no scent and I really like the pump bottle. This product would be great for anyone looking for a product to help calm their skin discomforts including tingling, burning sensations and tightness. I would purchase this product and recommend to my family and friends.

Love love love this!! Actually, I love all the Avene products I've tried but this one helped my daughter so I love it even more! Totally healed the mask rash she had from wearing her mask at school! Now we use it everyday just to keep her skin moisturized because it's been through so much. I love it for a little extra TLC for my skin…it's like a hug and I love it…did I mention that I love it? 🙃

This skin recovery balm is amazing! Does not dry the face. No tightness either. My skin was soft and had a nice glow to it. One product I actually liked using since my face is prone to being dry after washing it!!

I'm obsessed with this lotion. I have sensitive skin and I not only use it on my face, but also my neck & arms. It's so fast to soak in to my skin, I feel like my face is hydrated and glowing. I like that it doesn't sit on top of my skin as long as other products. Also, there's NO SMELL. I love it!
This is perfect in every way. There is no overbearing scent. It's light, it's not greasy and does a great job with every claim it makes.
I didn't use this product too much because it kind of broke my skin out. I have very sensitive skin and it made it a little inflamed.

It takes a lot for me to be impressed by a skin care product, as they all have so many amazing claims but most don't live up to them. This cream made my skin feel noticeably smoother/softer after about a week of use. I did not have a ton of redness at this time so can't say a lot about that, I do wish I took before after photos but right now my face is very red & covered with a pityrosporum rash so wouldn't have done much good. It did seem to calm the redness down after my morning application today though. (Full disclosure, I have pityrosporum & I did have the worst breakout I've ever had 3 days ago but I'm pretty sure it's related to my Prednisone burst, rather than this cream. I believe this cream is fungal acne safe.) I do like the packaging so far, however I'm concerned that once it gets more empty I'm not sure if the pump will allow all the product to come out. I've never seen this type of pump before so I'm interested to see how it holds up. Price is on the high end for the amount you get.
I love the packaging and the formula. It absorbs into your skin really well and it doesn't leave a greasy layer. I really like this moisturizer and I will be using it for a while

My husband and I have been trying this moisturizer for the last couple of weeks, especially to help wiggle his dry, reactive skin. It is helping so much. He no longer has dry, flaky skin under his beard or between his eyes.

I have sensitive, dry skin with occasional dry patches here or there during the colder months. This balm is great it's super lightweight and doesn't irritate my skin. When applying on my skin it feels so smooth and I can see my skin hydrated looking in the morning. After 2 uses my face felt really smooth and looked hydrated and plump I'm very impressed. My favorite thing it works for my sensitive skin and the tube pump, it gives me the right amount with 2 pumps. Will definitely buy products from Avene.
I would love to give this 5 stars, but I don't love the way this smells or how greasy my face feels after applying it. With that said, I do think it works well!

I tried to this product first on my heel because I have some redness and irritation there. I'm really glad I did, because the product smells like Swiss cheese. I would not want that smell on my face. It absorbs fast, isn't sticky or greasy, and does soften my skin, so it's great for the feet, as long as it's far away from my nose! I was looking forward to trying this on parts of my face however. I really liked the pump dispensing method. This is a great product except for the smell.

I developed a skin sensitivity reaction to a product, and none of my "expensive" skin care products helped. My skin was dry, itchy, bumpy, sensitive to everything I tried. Avene's Soothing Skin Recovery Balm worked instantly to repair my skin. I have been using the balm twice a day for two weeks now, and my skin is smooth, hydrated, nourished. I highly recommend this product!
This is really good for extra dry skin or winter skin! Extremely hydrating. It is super gentle on skin, mine is quite sensitive and I've had no issues at all with it.
I started using this and after two weeks I'm ready to change this to my get to my everyday balm. This leaves my skin very smooth and reduces the redness you get with age.

avis.titre: Avène Skin Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm
avis.texte: This is by far the best product for soothing and moisturizing my face and neck that I have found to date. Avène outranks other products that I have found that compare to this it is instant relief and long-lasting non-greasy formula I would recommend us to anyone looking for long-lasting results that are non greasy moisturizing and instantly soothing and repairing including my friends and family I will regularly be purchasing Avène for my daily skin care routine.

Let me start off by saying I love all Avene products. I have extremely dry, fair, sensitive skin. I love that this balm calms my itchy redness but doesn't cause that greasy feeling that other products do. It makes my skin look even and dewy.

I tend to have combination skin, so can be a bit all over the place, but more often than not, I tend to get very red and flushed. I recently came across this product and was looking for something to both moisturize and reduce redness. The packaging is compact and appreciate the pump vs squeeze tube. The product has zero smell which I feel is so hard to find so can tell it's truly fragrance-free. Even on my inflamed face it didn't burn or sting and I felt a moisturized feel but not greasy or absorbed immediately, so a great balance. A little went a long way so my face felt calm and relaxed and redness / evenness definitely improved.

This product is good but it's not great. It made my skin feel soft and moisturized but also made it feel sticky even after letting it dry. It has absolutely no smell at all which is nice. I like the pump bottle that is easy to use and comes with a lid for traveling. Overall, I like it enough to finish it but not enough to purchase in the future.

I have severely dry skin which is prone to sensitivity. I struggle with the skin on my nose particularly, it is usually scaly and makeup looks awful on top of the uneven surface. Despite my best skincare routine, I still struggle to manage the scaly patches. This moisturizer has been a true game changer for me. I absolutely love it and am ordering another one as a backup! If you have dry or sensitive skin- I 100% recommend you try this product.

avis.titre: Avène Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm
avis.texte: Avène Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm Has calmed my irritated itchy skin quickly!

avis.titre: A little goes a long way!
avis.texte: I received this product as a free sample in exchange for my honest review. The packaging is great. I like the pump. The product is thick so only a small amount is needed. It is not greasy. I would recommend. I have combination skin.
I love Avéne products and the Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm did not disappoint. This product was perfect for everyday use, as it did not irritate my skin and refresh my skin.

I got this free as part of a program and while it's soothing on my combination skin, it's even more amazing on my 4yos skin! Her skin is so dry and she breaks out in eczema so easily. This rich cream really works too help restore skin's barrier while soothing her visible redness, tightness and over-heating. It's infused with postbiotics to calm sensations of skin discomfort And I don't mind putting in on her since it's preservative free!!!

I used the Avené Tolerance Control Soothing Skin Recovery Balm for a while and I can say I like it. I usually used Neutrogena for my face in the mornings and switched to Avené. I saw a difference on my skin. It felt soother, smoother, and light on my skin. I would recommend to friends and family. I see myself purchasing this in the future.
Non greasy feeling and very soothing on my skin. I could tell my face was instantly soothed and the redness and tightness has lessened
This balm is gentle but keeps my face hydrated and not irritated. I don't hate the smell and the texture is perfect.

My poor face is struggling from wearing masks all the time. I'm breaking out in some places and extra dry in others. This has absolutely saved my skin. It is so much more balanced and less blotchy than when I first started using it.

I love this lotion, especially after just washing my face. My skin usually gets red right away after applying lotion of any kind but not with this one. I love the way you can't even tell you put it on, my skin looks and feels so much better! No more red face after application!
